accepted_causal_chain: Rerun134 correctly found one-second generic transitions, and rerun136 proves the common 250 ms guard closed that observation gap.
Faster reconsideration alone exposed a deeper limitation: the same stable movement or hold action remained the only legal branch for repeated 250 ms decisions.

Generation 13 contained one large split trash handoff and one strict hazard-exit wave; generation 14 contained a 17-follower no-victim activation that assigned the healer during an already accepted stable approach.

Roar, Swipe, Growl, Charge, Fade, and Misdirection were not silently disabled: the trace contains legal submissions where available, but local-radius threat actions could not acquire remote identities before physical repositioning completed.

The smallest shared behavior correction is therefore to accelerate only an already accepted Feral movement path with native Bear-form Stampeding Roar while current same-party healer exposure is visible. It must not create, replace, or redirect movement and must fall through unchanged when the spell is unknown, unavailable, or rejected.

causal_waves.finding: The Feral reconsidered at approximately 250 ms, preserved a stable handoff target, and submitted three legal Roars, but remote-cluster travel plus post-cast handoffs kept four to ten hostiles on the healer for multiple native-GCD cycles.
causal_waves.name: generation_13_split_trash_cluster

causal_waves.finding: Strict hazard movement retained authority for more than five seconds. Two legal Swipe submissions did not acquire the remote ten-hostile cluster; Fade became observable only at the end of the interval and Charge followed after the hard dwell gate had already failed.
causal_waves.name: generation_13_hazard_exit_split_wave

causal_waves.finding: A 17-follower no-victim wave assigned the healer while the Feral was already on a stable approach. Exact-healer movement, a partial local Roar, remote-cluster handoff, and a second partial Roar consumed 3.3 seconds before most ownership transferred and 4.6 seconds before the final two identities cleared.
causal_waves.name: generation_14_azil_split_swarm

comparison.finding: The common Feral 250 ms decision cap was active, but did not convert the newly realized split waves into threat recovery. The regression is behavioral travel/action starvation, not a remaining one-second observation gap.

evidence_limitations: Trace destination fields describe route context and do not expose every ActivePath endpoint or exact path length, so the diagnosis does not claim a specific geometric shortening.
Serialized combat_attempt can describe the prior attempted action and is not used to infer failure of the current labeled action.
The evidence proves movement-dominated starvation but cannot guarantee one speed-buff submission will pass every future realization; the next immutable canary remains authoritative.
The timer-only guard is retained because it demonstrably closes the rerun134 one-second observation gap; rerun136 rejects only sufficiency, not its bounded scope.

hypotheses.evidence: All representative failing sequences show approximately 250 ms Feral decisions.
hypotheses.name: common_250_ms_guard_did_not_execute

hypotheses.evidence: Rerun136 produced 228/1832 exposure and 34 long episodes despite the guard. The selected branches repeatedly had no immediate legal remote threat action while accepted movement was still in flight.
hypotheses.name: common_250_ms_guard_is_sufficient

hypotheses.evidence: The ordinary and Azil handoff traces retained stable target identities across repeated continuation actions; source continuation guards preserve already accepted endpoints.
hypotheses.name: common_guard_caused_path_reset_or_target_churn

hypotheses.evidence: Canonical (bot_guid, sequence) deduplication and unchanged 3000 ms grace independently reproduced 1578/1832 retention, 228/1832 exposure, and 5634 ms maximum dwell.
hypotheses.name: audit_scope_or_denominator_error

hypotheses.evidence: Current PID/epoch/session identity, exact party, all 14 terminals, four real boss deaths, all non-Feral gates, cleanup, receipt, and remote DVC state independently matched.
hypotheses.name: route_identity_publication_cleanup_or_other_role_failure

hypotheses.evidence: Every representative long wave consists mainly of accepted movement/continuation/hold decisions at 250 ms cadence; legal local threat actions recover only reached clusters, while remote identities remain on the healer.
hypotheses.name: movement_duration_is_the_shared_starvation_surface

hypotheses.evidence: Feral tank provisioning references Stampeding Roar and the runtime can fail closed through HasSpell/TryCastFriendlySpell. Casting it only while an already accepted path remains active changes neither destination nor hazard geometry and directly targets the measured travel-dominated interval.
hypotheses.name: native_movement_acceleration_can_reduce_starvation_without_weakening_authority

independent_node_reconstruction.finding: All healer-targeting eligible contributions and all 34 strict dwell violations were isolated to route generations 13 and 14.

smallest_safe_correction.change: After the existing identity-scoped healer-exposure scan caps DecisionTimer, conditionally submit native Bear-form Stampeding Roar (77761) on self. Record and return only on a successful cast. Do not create, replace, clear, or retarget the existing path; unavailable or illegal casts fall through to unchanged hazard, handoff, density, and route logic.
